answer: Because the timing is logged against the willow challenge, the quill audit can replay the copper history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 280 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3122 identities would post 1788 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
